maker: RDT (S. Liu et al., Tsinghua University)
name: RDT-1B
family: Diffusion transformer for bimanual manipulation (SigLIP, T5-XXL)

sources.title: S. Liu et al., RDT-1B: a Diffusion Foundation Model for Bimanual Manipulation, arXiv:2410.07864 (HTML version)
sources.covers: the 384 × 384 padded input, three cameras, the chunk size T_a = 64, the 6 Hz chunk rate on an RTX 4090

sources.title: thu-ml/RoboticsDiffusionTransformer (official code), commit cd79363: scripts/agilex_model.py, configs/base.yaml, configs/dataset_control_freq.json, README.md
sources.covers: expand2square (centred padding with the image mean colour), num_cameras, action_chunk_size, the SigLIP checkpoint siglip-so400m-patch14-384, the agilex control frequency, the MIT licence

note: Each image is padded to a square and resized to 384 × 384 keeping its aspect ratio (the paper); the code's expand2square centres the image and fills the rest with the image processor's mean colour, not black (the geometry is crop_rule resize_pad; the fill colour differs). The image encoder is SigLIP so400m with 14 px patches at 384 px; the tokens per image are not stated. Three views (exterior, right wrist, left wrist; a single-arm wrist camera is treated as the right wrist and missing views are padded) and two frames of history (T_img = 2). The inference rate is the paper's on the robot's onboard RTX 4090 with DPM-Solver++ at 5 steps: 6 chunks per second (166.7 ms each); the OpenVLA-OFT paper measured RDT-1B at 0.297 s per chunk on an A100 (Table III, not entered). control_hz 25 is the fine-tuning robot's (configs/dataset_control_freq.json: "agilex": 25). Code, weights and data MIT. DexVantage bundles these figures only.

input_resolution.quote: "each image is padded into a square and resized to 384×384, keeping its origin aspect ratio"

crop_rule.quote: agilex_model.py expand2square: result.paste(pil_img, (0, (width - height) // 2)) (centred), background_color = image_processor.image_mean

n_cameras.quote: configs/base.yaml: num_cameras: 3; the paper: "N_cam represents the number of cameras, set to three in our configuration"

action_chunk.quote: "the action chunk size is T_a=64" (configs/base.yaml: action_chunk_size: 64)

inference_ms.quote: "achieving an action chunk inference frequency of 6 Hz (action chunks per second) and an average action inference frequency of 381 Hz (actions per second) on the target robot's onboard RTX 4090 24GB GPU" (1000 / 6 = 166.7 ms)
